entries.note: baseline snapshot at adoption of skill-provenance/v1
inject shared interaction-policy v1 managed region
add key-hygiene bullets to the API-key section (never print/echo/log key values; reference by env-var name; treat transcripts/logs as shareable)
sharpen key-hygiene intro: leaks observed across multiple coding-agent CLI families (Codex, Claude, Gemini), not one tool's quirk (round 2 of sim-testbed findings, 20-cell wave)
add a Tips-for-Good-Datasets bullet: reserve a holdout slice before tuning; never tune and validate on the same rows (Traigent/traigent-smartopt#88, #89)
document the TRAIGENT_DATASET_ROOT / CWD dataset sandbox: default root is the current working directory; outside paths raise ConfigurationError via func.optimize (wrapping ValidationError)

restamp version-sensitive claims (verified live on SDK 0.21.0): `traigent algorithms` lists auto + smart selector names with availability since 0.20.1 (#1751, fixed in 0.20.1); supported smart names bind to the typed backend Optuna strategy and nsga2/cmaes fail fast since 0.20.1 (#1752/#1758); plan/next-steps --backend-url honors the stored auth-login URL before the localhost fallback since 0.20.0 (#1721). State that `traigent models --check` is a shipped-snapshot ID-shape preflight with pattern fallback that cannot detect provider-side delisting. Dedupe the doubled offline-mode exports in the Literal First Run block and hoist them above the first python invocation (mirrors references/literal-quickstart.sh); remove the editorial '(read on all current SDK versions)' markers that leaked into references/environment-variables.md code blocks. Fix skills#173: `traigent auth login` stores the key in the encrypted store at ~/.traigent/secure_credentials.enc (TRAIGENT_MASTER_PASSWORD), not ~/.traigent/credentials; legacy plaintext credentials.json is ignored unless TRAIGENT_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT_CREDENTIALS=true.

collapse inline SDK-version stamps into the authoritative docs/version-matrix.md rows with `see version-matrix: <fact_id>` pointers; restamp smart-selector executability to the verified 0.20.1 boundary (Traigent/traigent-skills#221; fact E per #190)
add portable audience, topic, lifecycle-stage, and maturity metadata; instructional body unchanged
